title: ID0378904-DC/Si-D/PT[170000492] - OCPP related issue
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: OCPP related issue
Root cause:
Nothing wrong → backend is not charging for extra time
Solution:
Provide info to RC → Nothing wrong → backend is not charging for extra time
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Siemens
Warranty Status:
Active
We have detected a customer that connects to the charger on a daily basis, for more than 4 hours straight. We are affraid that this user may have spoted some irregularity with the charger, as not reporting correctly to the backend (for example) and as a consequence not being charged for the amount of time it occupies the plug. Initially, the car charges up to 100% and after this there is a "StopTransaction" command and the charger enters into a "Finishing" condition. It remains like this for +4h and once the user is ready to leave, the charger goes back to "Preparing" and only then "Available". We have not yet contacted the backend operator (CPO) as we are afraid to raise an issue without being prepared to address it.
Note from L3:
Please proceed to close the ticket.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0378904-DC/Si-D/PT[170000492] - OCPP related issue CRM:00315001750
additional_info.body:
Olá Francisco,
Obrigado por acompanharem o tema.
Envio em anexo os Logs de algumas sessões que este mesmo utilizador realizou (de notar que usa sempre a mesma plug . ConnectorId 3).
Filtrei apenas pelo OCPP para tentar perceber o que está a ser enviado para o backend, porque conforme tive oportunidade de partilhar com o João, apesar de o carregador estar a enviar um “Finishing”, a aplicação da MIOO (por exemplo), reporta que o carregador já está disponível (print em anexo).
Outra curiosidade que encontrei é que, ao contrário de outras sessões onde a sequecia é “Finishing” -> “Available”, sempre que este utilizador lá está, a sequencia é “Finishing” – passam-se 6 horas -> “Preparing” -> “Available”
Se quiserem podemos agendar reunião
😉
PS: são 16:30 e o “sacana” ainda lá está
